text.tspan: IAM security tools: credential report vs access advisor
IAM Credential Report (ACCOUNT level)
One CSV listing EVERY user in the account and the
status of their credentials:
• password enabled? last used? last changed?
• MFA active?
• access key 1 / 2 active? last rotated? last used?
Use it to find: users without MFA, old keys (>90 days),
unused passwords / keys → audits, compliance
Console: IAM → Credential report → Download
New report at most every 4 hours
IAM Access Advisor (USER level)
Tab on a user, group, role or policy:
• which SERVICES its policies allow
• when each service was LAST ACCESSED
Use it to find permissions that are never used,
then remove them → least privilege
Console: IAM → Users → <user> → Last accessed
(this tab is what the course calls Access Advisor)
History shown for up to 400 days
Hook: Credential report = Census of the whole Country (account). Access Advisor = Audit of one person (user).
Don't confuse with IAM Access ANALYZER: finds resources shared OUTSIDE your account (public S3 bucket, cross-account role),
unused access, and can validate or generate policies from CloudTrail activity.
